researches.name: Guild Tillage
researches.description: Blesses the fields of all alliance members, maximizing grain and wheat yield.

effects.explanation: Increases all members' Food Production by +3.5% per level (Up to +35%).

researches.name: Timber Processing
researches.description: Introduces alliance-wide logging optimizations and saw techniques.

effects.explanation: Increases all members' Wood Production by +3.5% per level (Up to +35%).

researches.name: Stonemason Guild
researches.description: Standardizes structural quarry stone cuts and extraction tools.

effects.explanation: Increases all members' Stone Production by +3.0% per level (Up to +30%).

researches.name: Iron Smelting
researches.description: Distributes bellows and heat-management tech to alliance ironworks.

effects.explanation: Increases all members' Iron Production by +2.5% per level (Up to +25%).

researches.name: Commerce Union
researches.description: Regulates inter-alliance markets to minimize taxation on traded supplies.

effects.explanation: Deducts 2.0% tax fee per level from trading post resource shipments (Up to 10% lower tax).

researches.name: Unity of Shields
researches.description: Teaches tightly coordinated shield wall formations for infantry troops.

effects.explanation: Bolsters alliance-wide Infantry Defense by +2.0% per level (Up to +30%).

researches.name: Combined Drills
researches.description: Inoculates cavalry steeds against heavy battlefield screams and fires.

effects.explanation: Increases alliance-wide Cavalry Attack by +2.0% per level (Up to +30%).

researches.name: Windrunners
researches.description: Equips marksmen forces with lightweight travel quivers and lighter boots.

effects.explanation: Increases alliance-wide Marksmen Attack by +2.0% per level (Up to +30%).

researches.name: Dreadnought Tactics
researches.description: Conditions overall cardiovascular capacity and endurance in high-density armor.

effects.explanation: Increases Health of all deployed unit types by +1.5% per level (Up to +15%).

researches.name: War Host
researches.description: Unlocks advanced tactics for synchronizing larger combined rally marches.

effects.explanation: Increases maximum Alliance Rally Capacity by +50,000 per level (Up to +250,000).

researches.name: Border Expansion
researches.description: Enables the construction of auxiliary watchtowers to expand sovereign lines.

effects.explanation: Increases the maximum alliance watchtower limit by +3 per level (Up to +15 towers).

researches.name: Fortress Bulwarks
researches.description: Reinforces alliance fortress foundations with thick lime plaster and deep mortar layers.

effects.explanation: Boosts maximum Alliance Fortress durability points by +5.0% per level (Up to +50%).

researches.name: Territory Sentry
researches.description: Places eagle-scout glasses atop alliance structures to pierce through war fog.

effects.explanation: Expands territory watch range of all alliance fortresses/towers by +10.0% per level (Up to +50%).

researches.name: Resource Dominance
researches.description: Enhances coordination when harvesting within the alliance's secure borders.

effects.explanation: Boosts gathering speed by +2.5% per level when collecting on alliance territory (Up to +25%).

researches.name: Rapid Relocate
researches.description: Simplifies administrative and magic procedures for moving cities to alliance lands.

effects.explanation: Decreases the cooldown timer of Alliance Relocate scrolls by 5.0% per level (Up to 25% faster).

researches.name: Swift Aid
researches.description: Increases urgency drill speed of defensive marches heading to allied nodes.

effects.explanation: Speeds up alliance reinforcement march speeds by +4.0% per level (Up to +40%).

researches.name: Medicine Sharing
researches.description: Shares elite herbal knowledge and sanitization standards cross-guild.

effects.explanation: Accelerates member hospital recovery rates by +3.0% per level (Up to +30%).

researches.name: Mutual Assistance
researches.description: Increases the efficiency of peer construction and research help triggers.

effects.explanation: Adds +15 seconds of direct timer reduction per received alliance help trigger (Up to +150 seconds).

researches.name: Stamina Infusion
researches.description: Provides specialized camp training that accelerates hero stamina replenishment.

effects.explanation: Boosts all members' hero Stamina recovery rates by +4.0% per level (Up to +20%).

researches.name: Bounty Division
researches.description: Triggers bonus resource divisions inside premium alliance gift chests.

effects.explanation: Sparks +1.5% bonus resource counts when opening any alliance victory box (Up to +15%).
